scientific_integrity: An unrestricted-depth mathematical argument is supplied; computational tests corroborate finite cases only. The priority comparison is not a proof of historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Finite full Cartesian grids and one-point induced deletions only; named, reflexive equivalence relations E,F; both coordinate sizes >=2; no counting, constants, coordinate sorts or extra relations. Historical priority qualified by accessible literature coverage and risk of unlocated general finite-variable results.
title: A sharp finite-variable spectrum for singly punctured equivalence grids
